pages.title: Minecraft Zombie Wandering Curiously In A Bamboo Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Zombie wanders curiously through a bamboo jungle in this printable coloring page, stepping between tall narrow stalks beside broad-leaf plants and small layered blocks. Pointed leaves extend from the segmented stems above its head, while sparse angular patches decorate the character's plain shirt and straight rectangular limbs.

pages.title: Minecraft Zombie Posing Happily In A Castle Base Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Zombie poses happily in a castle base in this printable coloring page, spreading both arms with a broad smile beneath the square battlements overhead. A torch hangs beside a recessed window, and a closed chest sits on a low table against the brick-patterned wall behind the wide-legged figure.

pages.title: Minecraft Zombie Looking At The Sky Near A Lava Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Zombie looks at the sky near a lava cave in this printable coloring page, standing beneath long stepped clouds beside a patterned descending flow. The lava runs through a cut in the blocky rock face, while distant trees and a sharp mountain peak fill the gaps behind the character.

pages.title: Minecraft Zombie Roaring Playfully In The End Dimension Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Zombie roars playfully in the End dimension in this printable coloring page, raising both arms in front of bridges linking tall floating rock islands. Its open mouth and square teeth dominate the central pose, while smaller figures, hovering cubes, and a chest appear across the surrounding platforms.

pages.title: Minecraft Zombie Looking Around Curiously In A Sky Base Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Zombie looks around curiously in a sky base in this printable coloring page, standing on a central island joined to smaller platforms by narrow block bridges. Small patterned cubes and upright posts occupy the outer islands, while loose fragments, rounded clouds, and a plain sun fill the open sky.

pages.title: Minecraft Zombie Listening Carefully On A Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Zombie listens carefully on a bridge in this printable coloring page, raising both hands beside its square head above a wide stone arch below. The character's open mouth and bent knees give the pose expression, while a stream, low bushes, and sharp mountain peaks frame the crossing.

pages.title: Minecraft Zombie Stomping Playfully In A Castle Base Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Zombie stomps playfully in a castle base in this printable coloring page, lifting one block-shaped knee in front of a broad tower and gateway. The figure appears as a mostly solid silhouette with tiny square eyes, contrasting with the outlined battlements, narrow windows, bushes, and tiled ground around it.

pages.title: Minecraft Zombie Holding a Flower on a Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: A Minecraft Zombie holds a flower on a bridge in this printable coloring page, extending the tall stem above a plank walkway enclosed by straight wooden rails. The blossom has a stepped outline and square center, with blocky trees, distant houses, and layered banks completing the landscape beyond the crossing.
